description: Locate the GDAP1 fatty-acid ligand relative to mapped G-site and H-site, and map GDAP1-specific insertions

import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
t0=time.time()
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L',
 'LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def fetch_raw(pid):
    r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60)
    if r.status_code==200 and not r.text.lstrip().startswith('<'): return 'pdb',r.text
    return 'cif',requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",timeout=60).text
def finalize(ch):
    return {c:[{'resi':int(k[0]),'icode':k[1],'resn':v['resn'],'aa':AA3.get(v['resn'],'X'),'atoms':v['atoms']}
               for k,v in sorted(d.items(),key=lambda x:(int(x[0][0]),x[0][1]))] for c,d in ch.items()}
def parse_pdb_text(txt):
    ch={}; het=[]
    for l in txt.split('\n'):
        rec=l[:6].strip()
        if rec not in ('ATOM','HETATM') or len(l)<54: continue
        if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        resn=l[17:20].strip(); chain=l[21]; resi=l[22:26].strip(); ic=l[26]
        name=l[12:16].strip(); xyz=[float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]
        if rec=='HETATM' and resn not in AA3: het.append((chain,resn,resi,name,xyz)); continue
        ch.setdefault(chain,{}).setdefault((resi,ic),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][name]=xyz
    return finalize(ch),het
def parse_cif_text(txt):
    lines=txt.split('\n'); i=0; ch={}; het=[]
    while i<len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'):
            cols=[]
            while lines[i].startswith('_atom_site.'): cols.append(lines[i].strip().split('.')[1]); i+=1
            idx={c:k for k,c in enumerate(cols)}
            while i<len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('#'):
                f=lines[i].split()
                if len(f)<len(cols): i+=1; continue
                if f[idx['label_alt_id']] not in ('.','A'): i+=1; continue
                if 'pdbx_PDB_model_num' in idx and f[idx['pdbx_PDB_model_num']]!='1': i+=1; continue
                grp=f[idx['group_PDB']]; resn=f[idx['label_comp_id']]
                chain=f[idx.get('auth_asym_id',idx['label_asym_id'])]; resi=f[idx.get('auth_seq_id',idx['label_seq_id'])]
                name=f[idx['label_atom_id']].strip('"')
                xyz=[float(f[idx['Cartn_x']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_y']]),float(f[idx['Cartn_z']])]
                if grp=='HETATM' and resn not in AA3: het.append((chain,resn,resi,name,xyz)); i+=1; continue
                ch.setdefault(chain,{}).setdefault((resi,' '),{'resn':resn,'atoms':{}})['atoms'][name]=xyz
                i+=1
            break
        i+=1
    return finalize(ch),het
def load(pid):
    f,t=fetch_raw(pid); return parse_pdb_text(t) if f=='pdb' else parse_cif_text(t)
def ca_array(res):
    k=[r for r in res if 'CA' in r['atoms']]; return np.array([r['atoms']['CA'] for r in k],float),k
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0); qc=Q.mean(0); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
def nw_fast(S,g=-0.6):
    n,m=S.shape; F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1)); F[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1); F[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1); jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        G=np.empty(m+1); G[0]=-1e9; G[1:]=np.maximum(F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1],F[i-1,1:]+g)
        b=np.empty(m+1); b[0]=F[i,0]; b[1:]=G[1:]-g*jj[1:]
        F[i]=np.maximum.accumulate(b)+g*jj
    i,j=n,m; pairs=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if abs(F[i,j]-(F[i,j-1]+g))<1e-9: j-=1
        elif abs(F[i,j]-(F[i-1,j-1]+S[i-1,j-1]))<1e-9: pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); i-=1; j-=1
        else: i-=1
    return pairs[::-1]
def tmalign(Xq,Xt):
    n,m=len(Xq),len(Xt); L=min(n,m); d0=max(1.24*(L-15)**(1/3)-1.8,0.5)
    seeds=[(i,j,Ls) for Ls in [L,L//2,L//4] if Ls>=12
           for i in range(0,n-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2)) for j in range(0,m-Ls+1,max(1,Ls//2))]
    best=(0,None,None,None)
    for si,sj,Ls in seeds:
        R,t=kabsch(Xq[si:si+Ls],Xt[sj:sj+Ls]); pairs=None
        for it in range(8):
            Xm=Xq@R.T+t; D=np.linalg.norm(Xm[:,None,:]-Xt[None,:,:],axis=2)
            newp=nw_fast(1/(1+(D/d0)**2))
            if pairs==newp: break
            pairs=newp; cur=np.array(pairs)
            for cut in (d0+4,d0+2,d0):
                Xm=Xq@R.T+t; dd=np.linalg.norm(Xm[cur[:,0]]-Xt[cur[:,1]],axis=1); sel=cur[dd<cut]
                if len(sel)<10: break
                R,t=kabsch(Xq[sel[:,0]],Xt[sel[:,1]])
        if not pairs: continue
        Xm=Xq@R.T+t; ix=np.array(pairs); d=np.linalg.norm(Xm[ix[:,0]]-Xt[ix[:,1]],axis=1)
        tm=float(np.sum(1/(1+(d/d0)**2))/L)
        if tm>best[0]: best=(tm,pairs,R,t)
    return best

gd,gdhet=load('7AIA'); GD=gd['AAA']; Xq,Rq=ca_array(GD)
RF8=np.array([h[4] for h in gdhet if h[1]=='RF8'],float)
t1,h1=load('2C3Q'); Xt,Rt=ca_array(t1['A'])
GTX=np.array([h[4] for h in h1 if h[1]=='GTX' and h[0]=='A'],float)
GTXn=[h[3] for h in h1 if h[1]=='GTX' and h[0]=='A']
tm,pairs,R,t=tmalign(Xq,Xt)
# GSH moiety vs hexyl (H-site) atoms of S-hexylglutathione
hex_names=[n for n in GTXn if n in ('C1','C2','C3','C4','C5','C6')]
isx=np.array([n in ('C1','C2','C3','C4','C5','C6') for n in GTXn])
GSHpart=GTX[~isx]; HEXpart=GTX[isx]
Gsite=((GSHpart-t)@R); Hsite=((HEXpart-t)@R)
print("GDAP1 vs GSTT1 theta: TM=%.3f, aligned pairs=%d"%(tm,len(pairs)))
print("RF8 (hexadecanedioic acid) atoms: %d ; centroid distance to mapped G-site centroid = %.1f A, to mapped H-site(hexyl) centroid = %.1f A"
      %(len(RF8),np.linalg.norm(RF8.mean(0)-Gsite.mean(0)),np.linalg.norm(RF8.mean(0)-Hsite.mean(0))))
trRF8=cKDTree(RF8)
dG,_=trRF8.query(Gsite); dH,_=trRF8.query(Hsite)
print("min distance from each mapped G-site atom to nearest RF8 atom: median %.1f A, min %.1f A"%(np.median(dG),dG.min()))
print("min distance from each mapped H-site(hexyl) atom to nearest RF8 atom: median %.1f A, min %.1f A"%(np.median(dH),dH.min()))

# GDAP1 insertions relative to the theta GST core (unaligned GDAP1 stretches >=5 residues)
alnq=set(i for i,j in pairs)
res_ids=[r['resi'] for r in Rq]
runs=[]; cur=[]
for k,r in enumerate(res_ids):
    if k not in alnq: cur.append(r)
    else:
        if len(cur)>=5: runs.append((cur[0],cur[-1],len(cur)))
        cur=[]
if len(cur)>=5: runs.append((cur[0],cur[-1],len(cur)))
print("\nGDAP1 segments with no structural equivalent in GSTT1 (>=5 res):",runs)

# RF8 contacts in GDAP1
allat=[(r['resi'],r['aa'],n,x) for r in GD for n,x in r['atoms'].items() if n[0]!='H']
X=np.array([a[3] for a in allat],float)
d=np.linalg.norm(X[:,None,:]-RF8[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
cont=sorted(set((allat[k][0],allat[k][1]) for k in np.where(d<4.5)[0]))
print("\nGDAP1 residues within 4.5 A of hexadecanedioic acid (%d): %s"%(len(cont),', '.join(f"{a}{i}" for i,a in cont)))
inins=[f"{a}{i}" for i,a in cont if any(s<=i<=e for s,e,_ in runs)]
print("of which lie in GDAP1-specific insertions:",inins)

# ---- summary figure ----
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
labels=['H30','W31','S34','F35','S36','K39','L58','G75','E76','V77','P78','E89','A90']
cons=[93.3,93.3,93.3,93.3,73.3,93.3,100,100,100,100,100,66.7,73.3]
gstref=['Y7 (pi, catalytic)','F8 (pi)','S11 theta / C32 omega (catalytic)','Q12 (theta)','P13 (theta)','R37 (omega)',
        'L35 (theta)','K52/G52','K53/L71','V54 (cis-Pro-1)','P55 (cis-Pro)','E66/E85 (gamma-Glu)','S67/S86 (gamma-Glu)']
colors=['#4C78A8']*len(labels); colors[-1]='#E45756'; colors[-2]='#F58518'
axes[0].barh(range(len(labels))[::-1],cons,color=colors)
axes[0].set_yticks(range(len(labels))[::-1]); axes[0].set_yticklabels([f"{l}  <- {g}" for l,g in zip(labels,gstref)],fontsize=8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("% of 30 vertebrate GDAP1 orthologs identical to human")
axes[0].set_title("Mapped G-site positions in GDAP1:\nconservation across vertebrate orthologs")
axes[0].set_xlim(0,105)
axes[0].text(2,0.2,"A90: Ala/Pro in all orthologs, Tyr in GDAP1L1;\nnever the Ser that binds the gamma-glutamyl amine",fontsize=8,color='#E45756')
labs=['mapped G-site\n(GSH position)','mapped H-site\n(S-hexyl position)']
axes[1].boxplot([dG,dH],labels=labs,widths=0.5)
axes[1].scatter(np.random.normal(1,0.04,len(dG)),dG,color='#4C78A8',zorder=3)
axes[1].scatter(np.random.normal(2,0.04,len(dH)),dH,color='#54A24B',zorder=3)
axes[1].axhline(4.5,ls='--',color='grey'); axes[1].text(2.3,4.7,'4.5 A contact',fontsize=8,color='grey')
axes[1].set_ylabel("distance to nearest hexadecanedioate atom (A)")
axes[1].set_title("Where the GDAP1 fatty-acid ligand sits relative to the\ncanonical GST sites mapped from GSTT1 (PDB 2C3Q)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("elapsed %.0fs"%(time.time()-t0))
